cases.name: rule
cases.when: `label` is absent or blank -- the divider is one <hr>
cases.reason: It renders a real <hr>, so the platform names its role, separator, the moment the element exists, and there is nothing to press, focus or dismiss. No pattern exists for a separator and none is proposed: the element carries its own semantics, and a vertical rule drawn by a class is still announced as a separator, which the prompt states.

cases.name: labelled
cases.when: `label` is set -- two decorative rules and the word between them
cases.reason: A separator is a leaf whose children are presentational, so a word placed inside one can be dropped by a reader. The word is therefore ordinary text between two rules hidden from assistive technology, and the case claims no role: what a reader meets is the word, in reading order, with nothing to operate.
